name: Tsukushi Renoir
source:
Star Sign: Pisces

[url=/c53458]Monet's[/url] older twin brother. He's currently studying in France.
An up-and-coming young painter.
Different from Monet, he is friendly, but he isn't the type to show his true feelings.
He's friendly with his cousin [url=/c53456]Rintarou[/url] and they get along well.
He loves bright colors and is always fussing about the color of his clothes and hair.
It seems he hasn't seen Monet in a long while...
